title: gwbench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Groundwater-Level Forecasting
description: A reproducible benchmark for daily groundwater-level forecasting built from public USGS NWIS data. The release contains the gwbench Python package, data download and processing scripts, processed daily panels (279 wells; 74-well clean core), persistence and model results, manuscript source and figures, and reproducibility instructions. Raw observations are available from the USGS National Water Information System.
